metadata.description: Spoken clause appended to a task-completion announcement when the task's durable verification_state is exactly `verified` — the repository's own checks ran and passed. This is the ONLY state that may be spoken as verified; `unknown` (the default for every task with no gate) deliberately has no template at all, so nothing is said rather than something implied. Deliberately one short sentence: it is read aloud immediately after the completion sentence, and a second clause there is the difference between a notification and a paragraph.
metadata.author: magician
